test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 25 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Which of the following statements is true?

options.text: The sum of the squared deviations of the items from the arithmetic mean is maximum.
Arithmetic mean is the sum of deviations from the mid value.
The sum of deviations of the items from the arithmetic mean is always one.
The sum of deviations of the items from the arithmetic mean is always zero.

solution:
**Formula used:**

The sum of deviations of the items from the arithmetic mean is always zero.

**Calculation:**

Let x₁, x₂, ..., x_n be a set of n observations and bar{x} be the arithmetic mean.

Sum of deviations from the mean: sumᵢ₌₁ⁿ (x_i - bar{x})

⇒ sumᵢ₌₁ⁿ x_i - sumᵢ₌₁ⁿ bar{x}

⇒ sumᵢ₌₁ⁿ x_i - n bar{x}

Since bar{x} = frac{sumᵢ₌₁ⁿ x_i}{n}

⇒ sumᵢ₌₁ⁿ x_i - n (frac{sumᵢ₌₁ⁿ x_i}{n})

⇒ sumᵢ₌₁ⁿ x_i - sumᵢ₌₁ⁿ x_i

⇒ 0

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
